name: Certificate
description: Completion and award certificates from the active brand - one name at a time, or a whole roster from a CSV in Bulk from rows.

inputs.label: Kind
inputs.help: Sets the wording: the title and the line above what the certificate is for. Leave the Title field empty to keep the wording in step with this.

inputs.label: Title
inputs.help: Leave empty to follow the Kind above.

inputs.label: Course or award
inputs.help: What the certificate is for - a course title, an award name, or the contribution being recognised.

inputs.label: Date
inputs.help: Printed in full above the date line, e.g. 18 June 2026.

inputs.label: Signed by
inputs.help: The name printed above the signature line. Leave empty to drop the whole signature column.

inputs.label: Issued by
inputs.help: Printed at the top when the brand ships no logo, or under it when it does.

inputs.label: Brand logo
inputs.help: Place the active brand's logo at the top - the light or dark version to suit the paper colour. Falls back to the Issued by line when the brand ships no logo.

inputs.label: Reference
inputs.help: Optional small line at the foot of the sheet. Plain text, exactly as typed - the tool never makes one up.

inputs.label: Sheet
inputs.help: Sets the sheet proportion and the exported page size.

inputs.label: Accent
inputs.help: Colours the border rules and the recipient's name.

guide.title: One certificate, or the whole roster

tracks.label: One person
steps: Pick a **Kind** - completion, achievement, award or appreciation. It writes the title and the line above the award topic, so leave **Title** empty unless you want your own wording.
Fill in the name, what it is for, and the date. **Signed by** and **Their role** print above and below the signature line; leave **Signed by** empty to drop that column.
**Sheet** sets the real page size. A4 and US Letter export at their true physical size, so a PDF prints as the page it says it is.

tracks.label: A whole roster
steps: Open **Bulk from rows** from the tool menu. It opens the batch grid with this tool already loaded.
Import a CSV whose columns are named **firstname**, **lastname**, **awardtopic** and **awarddate**. Those are the same input ids the badge and stationery tools use, so one roster feeds all of them.
Anything you leave out of the CSV keeps the value set here - the issuer, the signature line and the colours are filled in once for every row.
Export the whole run: each row renders its own sheet and they come back as one zip.
